_comment: Run/build the client against the real nexa-dev Supabase project: flutter run --dart-define-from-file=dart_define.example.json  (values here are the project's PUBLIC API address and its anon/publishable key — safe to commit by Supabase's own design; RLS is what protects data. The service-role key and SUPABASE_JWT_SECRET must never appear here.)
_NEXA_BACKEND_URL_note: Empty until the Nexa backend (apps/backend) is deployed with SUPABASE_JWT_SECRET + DATABASE_URL. Until then ProfileRepository / PhoneDeviceRepository / PairingSessionRepository honestly throw BackendNotConfiguredException and the UI shows its real error/empty states. For a local backend on the Android emulator use http://10.0.2.2:3000
